structured.answer: If I go by the page, it says the cheapest choice is an account at פסגות with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", and that after 10 years I would have about 86,492 ₪. That's with the numbers that were already filled in (10,000 ₪ to start, 500 ₪ a month, 7% a year), not numbers I chose. I wouldn't do anything before I ask you, because I don't know פסגות and I couldn't follow most of the page.

stuck.why: Dark page, and the very first buttons are English letters: 'MSCI AC World', 'MSCI World', 'S&P 500'. The heading says 'להשקיע במדד'. To me מדד is the price index on the news. I only kept going because the task said S&P 500.
The boxes already said 10,000, 500, 10 and 7 %. The task didn't give me amounts and I don't touch sliders, so I left them. I don't know if 86,492 means anything for me.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the two boxes 'הבחירה שלכם' and 'הזוג הבא בתור'
stuck.why: 86,492 and 86,449 are almost the same, and then there's '−43 ₪' under the second one. I didn't know what the 'זוג' (pair) is or why there is a minus.

stuck.where: Screen 2, between the account and the fund
stuck.why: Two lists side by side: accounts on the right, funds on the left, with a '+' between them. I didn't understand that I need both an account and a fund. I only worked it out from the top line: account פסגות, fund ילין לפידות.
Every row has red minus amounts like −447, −1,268, −4,492 and many coloured labels. It frightened me, and I couldn't tell whether a minus means losing money or just 'less than the cheapest'.
Whole rows in English (iShares, Vanguard, UCITS, IE00…), and 'אין מחיר כאן'. By here I was tired, and I stopped after screen 5.

unsure_meaning: מדד: here it seems to mean shares, not prices
קרן מחקה, קרן סל, צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד
'הזוג הבא בתור' and '−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם'
The red minus numbers in the fund list: a loss, or just more expensive?
'בכסף של היום', and whether the 7% is promised
The orange/yellow/red bars by each bank: colours too close to tell apart
not_found: Anything about deposits or safe saving to compare with
A place to type my own amount clearly, without the sliders
A plain sentence saying whether I could lose money
Which bank is mine, and what it is taking from me now

findings.what: Red minus amounts on almost every fund row; I couldn't tell whether it's money lost or just a difference from the cheapest, and it scared me
The page opens with English letters and investment words, nothing about safe saving; it feels like it isn't for me
findings.where: Screen 1, the buttons at the top

findings.what: The amounts were filled in already (10,000 / 500 / 10 / 7%), with sliders; it wasn't clear the big number came from those and not from me
It didn't explain simply that you need both an account and a fund, two separate lists
Too many coloured labels and numbers on one screen; I lost the line in the middle
Whole rows in English with codes like IE00B5BMR087
Small grey text under the banks ('לא בחישוב ...') and the explanation notes were hard to read
Orange, yellow and red bars that look alike, and no sentence saying what they mean
'פסגות' is not my bank; I don't know whether to trust it with money
